models

items.docs: Lists the currently available models, providing basic information about each model.

Deletes a service node by node id.

params.name: node
params.description: The ID of the node to use for this request

params.name: halt
params.description:
forces the deletion operation to halt requests being serviced
by these service nodes.

items.docs:
Removes a service node from the list of available service nodes.
If the service node is currently servicing requests, those requests
will be drained before halting service, unless `halt=true` is provided
in the query.

info.name: Populate information about a service node
service_nodes

items.docs: Lists the currently available service nodes, providing basic information about each node.

info.name: Gets a specific service node by node id.

params.name: node
params.description: The ID of the node to use for this request

access_tokens
Gets a list of all access tokens.

params.name: user
params.description: The ID of the user to filter access tokens

items.docs: Lists the currently available access tokens, providing basic information about each user.

info.name: Gets a information about a single access token.

params.name: token
params.description: The ID of the token to request info about

items.docs: Shows the selected access token, providing basic information about the token.

info.name: Deletes an access token by token id.

params.name: token
params.description: The ID of the access token to delete

items.docs:
Removes an access token from the list of available tokens.  The
access token will also be purged from the caches of all nodes
in the cluster

info.name: Create a new access token

items.docs:
Creates a new access token.  This is not directly populated into the
token cache until it has been used.  Note that the response contains
fields which are not stored in the database in plaintext and cannot
be retrieved at a future date.
